spellbook.finance/limitations: Execution cannot change approved targets, identities, expiry or actor. Stale or absent approval refuses submission.
Repeats refer to the same durable execution; unknown completion does not authorize a new send.
Already admitted writes may finish after revocation. Execution does not undo sales or cap cumulative price movement.

description: Execute the frozen targets of an owner-approved exact eBay pricing batch. First prepare with spellbook_ebay_pricing_approval_prepare and read owner approval with spellbook_ebay_pricing_approval_get. Returns durable execution and per-listing outcome evidence; read the same operation again to inspect progress.

operationId.description: Exact operation ID of the owner-approved prepared batch. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_ebay_pricing_approval_execute
